description: BeeAI RequirementAgent run with one tool call, traced by OpenInference.
notes: Only BeeAIInstrumentor is enabled. The model calls are covered by BeeAI's own llm spans, so the openai instrumentor is not needed; the page says not to enable it, or each call would be recorded twice and counted twice. LITELLM_LOCAL_MODEL_COST_MAP is True, set in main.py before anything is imported, so litellm does not download its cost map. The model goes through litellm, and the replies are JSON text the agent reads the tool choice from (response_format json_schema on the wire). The tree is weather-agent [agent], OpenAIChatModel [llm], get_weather [tool], OpenAIChatModel [llm], final_answer [agent] and final_answer [tool]. The llm spans report llm.cost.prompt, completion and total from litellm, so the cost is reported rather than computed. metadata.steps.0.id, metadata.steps.1.id, metadata.id, metadata.trace.id and metadata.trace.run_id are random per run and are listed as volatile. BeeAI mints each tool-call id from a random 8-character string, 13 characters with the call_ prefix, under the 16 that volatile_attributes needs to replace inside message JSON, so the program pins it to a counter.
